risks.finding: A4988 regulation accuracy is not specified at the selected ~0.6735V reference. Formula-only nominal phase limit0.350765A and manufacturer-rail/component upper formula value0.364518A do not include driver accuracy. No qualified maximum current claim.
risks.resolution: Scope phase/sense peak current over temperature/supply/decay/microstep states; satisfy motor0.4A per-phase limit with margin or change hardware.

risks.finding: Protected VM ADC switch/NPN host detection are implemented, but intermediate-rail behavior, fast collapse and charged10nF discharge are unqualified; VM OE must remain HIGH until rail valid. Firmware absent. PD-only ROM/pull-up ESD ghost-DATA and false active-low host detection are a specific untested boundary.
risks.resolution: Scope all PD/DATA connection/removal/order/ramp/brownout conditions at MCU pins and VDD; verify exact absolute limits, obtain manufacturer injection guidance, or add guaranteed hardware supervision/clamps.

risks.finding: Exact selected SRN4018-4R7M saturation/RMS/DCR criteria and effective buck capacitor values remain unverified; mounted AP63203/inductor/A4988/motor/sense temperatures and ground current sharing unmeasured.
risks.resolution: Obtain exact primary specifications, derating and selected-package evidence; run worst-case mounted thermal soak or revise the power components/architecture.

risks.finding: Exact selected TVS clamp/energy, ESD device and NPN primary limits, resistor pulse/hot tolerance and ceramic effective capacitance remain incomplete. Regenerative motor/load energy is unqualified.
risks.resolution: Complete exact-MPN primary evidence and transient/ripple/temperature qualification; revise protection if required.

risks.finding: Official motor drawing specifies front M3 threads, not independent rear mounting holes. Native rear recesses contain endcap fasteners. Separate front-thread carrier is a machined prototype candidate only.
risks.resolution: Prototype carrier/fasteners and qualify actual motor revision, thread engagement, load strength, cable exit and isolation; do not remove endcap fasteners for PCB mounting.

risks.finding: Native C178585 bulk capacitor STEP is5.82mm tall while manufacturer body height is7.7±0.3mm. Native model retained; independent manufacturer-maximum envelope screened.
risks.resolution: Verify actual production package and assembly clearance with correct supplier model or physical sample.

risks.finding: Both USB-C mouths face+Y atX±5.3mm, pitch10.6mm; compact overmolds≤10mm are a screening requirement. Physical simultaneous insertion/retention/strain relief not tested.
risks.resolution: Use actual intended compact PD/DATA cables and assembled carrier to qualify mating/retention/bend/fastener clearance.

risks.finding: Offline native/CAM audits pass their geometric scope; fab mask/stencil/annulus process acceptance and supplier CPL rotation/pickup orientation are not verified. No stock/price quote or assembly preview approval.
risks.resolution: Supplier reviews actual ZIP/BOM/CPL and package pick-up conventions; resolve mask/stencil policy and approve preview before any order.

risks.finding: USB hardware paths and boot/debug interfaces exist; firmware/protocol and actual USB enumeration/programming/motion have not been demonstrated.
risks.resolution: Implement correct reset-safe active-low host detection and VM OE sequencing, firmware flashing/USB control, then run bring-up checklist.

technical_evidence_scope: Offline source/copper/CAM/native3D/A4 review complete with explicitly preserved official placement advisories. Software geometric evidence is separate from stage qualification and supplier approval.
